newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen takes over Witzig & Frank.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen takes over Witzig & Frank.

text.p: Thyssen Industrie AG said on Tuesday it had taken over German company Witzig & Frank Turmatic GmbH and would integrate the firm into its machine building operations.

Witzig & Frank makes multi-access manufacturing cells -- a specialist type of jig with a universal joint for production of complex fittings. It employs 250 staff and has annual turnover of 100 million marks, Thyssen said in a statement.
A Thyssen spokesman declined to say how much the takeover cost. The company will remain under its present management.
